summary: Verified Founder Bundle ($59/mo, first 30, lifetime) end-to-end. Backend: GET /api/payments/founder-status returns {available:true, remaining:30, limit:30, plan_id:'bundle_founder', amount_cents:5900, display_price:'$59'}. POST /api/payments/checkout with plan_id='bundle_founder' creates a Stripe session and payment_transactions row records amount_cents=5900 (NOT 7500). Regression: bundle_monthly still records amount_cents=7500. Frontend: /precios?plan=bundle_founder (authenticated) renders founder-banner with 'FOUNDER OFFER', founder-spots '30 of 30 spots left', summary-price '$59', CTA 'Lock in my Founder price'. Month/Year toggle is hidden in founder mode. Clicking the CTA fires POST /api/payments/checkout with body {plan_id:'bundle_founder', origin_url:'https://negocio-preview-1.preview.emergentagent.com', num_cards:1} and the browser navigates to https://checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_test_... — Stripe payment NOT submitted (per instructions).

critical.issue: BUG (fixed by testing agent): payments_service.create_checkout_session passed subscription_data.trial_period_days=0 to Stripe, which rejects with 'The minimum number of trial period days is 1.' This blocked ALL subscription checkouts (founder AND all normal plans) with HTTP 500. Fix: only include trial_period_days when > 0 (payments_service.py L392-405). After the fix, both bundle_founder and bundle_monthly checkouts succeed and record correct amount_cents.

action_items: Confirm the payments_service.py fix (trial_period_days only when >0) — testing agent applied it because 100% of subscription checkouts were 500'ing. Consider adding a unit test guard and revisit whether any plan should have trial_period_days > 0 (currently ALL plans in _build_plans have 0, and the founder plan also uses 0).
critical_code_review_comments: payments_service.create_checkout_session was building subscription_data with 'trial_period_days': plan['trial_period_days'] regardless of value; Stripe requires >=1 or the field omitted entirely — this is now guarded.

founder_status counts users by subscription_status IN ('active','trialing','past_due'). If a founder user is later downgraded/canceled and status becomes 'canceled', their spot frees up. Confirm this is intended (founder is supposed to be lifetime), otherwise count by plan_type only.
Nice: server.py validates plan_id via get_plan() before hitting Stripe; founder cap is enforced inside create_checkout_session with a clear FOUNDER_SOLD_OUT error.
seed_data_creation: None. Founder counter still shows 30/30 remaining (no actual Stripe payment completed in testing).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Founder-plan e2e verified. Regression suite: /app/backend/tests/test_founder_plan.py runs against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Frontend logged-in user reaches Stripe checkout via /precios?plan=bundle_founder → CTA click. Note: testing agent fixed a pre-existing critical bug in payments_service.py (trial_period_days=0 rejected by Stripe) that would have blocked ALL checkout flows in prod — the fix is minimal and safe.
rca of the issue: Root cause of the previously-hidden bug: PLANS['*'] have trial_period_days=0 (product decision to remove the trial). create_checkout_session forwarded that 0 to Stripe as subscription_data.trial_period_days=0, and Stripe returns 400 'The minimum number of trial period days is 1.' The endpoint then wrapped it in an HTTP 500. Fix: only include the field when >0.
